title: Vision Transformers (ViT) in Image Recognition – 2024 Guide
extracted_text:
DEEP LEARNING

Author: Gaudenz Boesch
Date: November 25, 2023

Build, deploy, operate computer vision at scale

Vision Transformers (ViT) has recently emerged as a competitive alternative to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) that are currently state-of-the-art (SOTA) in different computer vision tasks. ViT models outperform the current SOTA CNNs by almost x4 in terms of computational efficiency and accuracy.
